title: The all-errors fixture misses collect's branch-fallback read, and everyHerdrMethod omits pane.close
description:
Two gaps in the guard that says collect answers from durable evidence without asking herdr, both found by mutation during the h0f review:

1. Injecting e.client.AgentGet into readReport's branch fallback (internal/exec/herdr/inspect.go:326 - the path taken when both the worktree copy and the archive are gone) passes every test in internal/exec/herdr. TestCollectReadsTheReportFromTheBranchWhenTheWorktreeIsGone drives that path but never counts herdr calls, so the all-errors fixture cannot see a call added there.

2. everyHerdrMethod omits pane.close, so a herdr call added on that method is invisible to the same guard.

The behaviour is right today; what is missing is the ability of the guard to notice if it stops being right. Same shape as 889: a property asserted by a test that cannot fail for the reason it was written.

acceptance_criteria: A herdr call injected into readReport's branch fallback fails the all-errors guard, and pane.close is in everyHerdrMethod. Both verified by making the injection and watching the guard fail.
